editionData.title: Canada to hit US with retaliatory tariffs as trade war escalates; Iran security chief Rezaei warns neighbours against joining US...
editionData.description: Global headlines: Canada to hit US with retaliatory tariffs as trade war escalates (Mark Carney says Canada will impose tariffs starting September 8 on imports of US steel, electronics and other products); Iran security chief Rezaei warns neighbours against joining US economic war (Official says any state joining US would be considered an enemy and Tehran would target their interests in retaliation); and Iran warns nearby nations against joining US ‘economic war’ efforts (The warning comes as US President Donald Trump threatens to isolate Iran economically to weaken its government). Markets leaned higher, with 5 of 7 tracked indexes up; HANG SENG INDEX up 1.21% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Figmimic – A bookmarklet to copy any webpage into Figma as editable layers (A bookmarklet to copy any webpage into Figma as editable layers); Scrap (2006) (I found some old journal entries. This one is probably circa ~2006, just titled "Scrap:" I moved to Pittsburgh at the right time in my...); and NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier (Compare 153 autonomous runs from 18 frontier models on the nanoGPT optimizer speedrun). Product Hunt features AutoClaw (An AI work agent across desktop, browser, and chat), Zero (Vercel's programming language built for AI agents), and Open Analytics (AI-Native Google Analytics alternative for the modern web).

headlines.title: Canada to hit US with retaliatory tariffs as trade war escalates

headlines.title: Tropical Storm Moke advances towards Hawaii with heavy rain, strong winds
headlines.summary: For the second week in a row, Hawaii Island, also known as the Big Island, faces threats from an intensifying storm.

headlines.title: Israeli army and settlers injure several Palestinians across West Bank
headlines.summary: Palestinians face attacks and forced displacement as settlers expand control, backed by military raids and inaction.

headlines.title: Trump administration's 75-country visa ban was illegal, judge rules
headlines.summary: The U.S. stopped issuing visas for citizens of 75 countries because it said they were likely to need public assistance. A judge ruled the policy illegally discriminated on the basis of nationality.

headlines.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers keeps finding a new neighborhood
headlines.summary: MLB catcher Jake Rogers probably didn't know if he was coming or going the last several weeks: he's been a Detroit Tiger, a Baltimore Oriole, a Boston Red Sox, and now he's a Chicago White Sox.

headlines.title: As Flock battles public scrutiny, other police surveillance companies see an opening
headlines.summary: Dozens of cities have canceled their contracts with Flock. Some are switching to other companies, but privacy experts say they're no better than Flock.

headlines.title: Hours after U.S. imposes tariffs, Canada says it'll strike back starting Sept. 8
headlines.summary: The U.S. has now imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian products. Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will match those tariffs "dollar for dollar" next month.

headlines.title: A battle over 'Italian brainrot' could shape who owns AI art
headlines.summary: A legal battle over what looks like a cartoon stick could help set the rules over whether creators can claim ownership of their AI-generated characters.

headlines.title: Soil, seed investment key to Africa's food resilience
headlines.summary: Greater investment in sustainable production, including healthier soils and climate-resilient seed systems, is key to strengthening Africa's food systems, while finance and markets are important in helping farmers adopt new practices and withstand shocks, African agricultural experts say.

headlines.title: Trump expands economic warfare against Iran
headlines.summary: US President Donald Trump has declared an "economic D-Day" against Iran amid a ceasefire deadlock, threatening countries that provide a lifeline to Tehran with "tremendous consequences".

headlines.title: Navigating Sino–European trade headwinds
headlines.summary: Trade relations between China and the European Union are feeling the heat following the release of the latest customs data in mid-July.

headlines.title: US debt tops $40t, stoking fiscal concern
headlines.summary: The United States Treasury Department said on Wednesday that total US government debt had surpassed $40 trillion, while announcing plans to at least double the maximum size of its liquidity-support buyback operations for longer-dated Treasury securities from $2 billion to at least $4 billion per operation.

headlines.title: Deeper China-Africa media relations urged
headlines.summary: African officials and media leaders called on Thursday for China-Africa media cooperation to move beyond equipment support and program exchanges toward coproduction and two-way storytelling, in order to help the African media better narrate their own stories and bring a wider African perspective to Chinese audiences.

headlines.title: Assam elephant habitat recovery hope rides on biochar from invasive plants
headlines.summary: Assam's project aims to restore elephant habitats by managing invasive plants and creating biochar for improved ecosystem health.

headlines.title: Nitin Nabin holds first meeting with BJP’s new national team
headlines.summary: BJP condemns Congress' decision on Vande Mataram, pledging to uphold its honor and launch a nationwide awareness campaign.

headlines.title: CJI advocates ‘Nyaya-nomics’ to drive growth
headlines.summary: CJI Surya Kant stresses on "Nyaya-nomics," emphasising justice's role in fostering economic growth through trust and predictability.

headlines.title: 'Risks weakening worker safeguards': Congress on SC's ‘industry’ definition judgment
headlines.summary: Congress warns that the Supreme Court's ruling risks weakening worker safeguards and creates uncertainty in labor relations.
